questiontext.text:
We have simulated data sets giving the crop yield for different crops. The outcome variable is the Crop Yield, and the explanatory variables are:

  • Soil Quality Index Score - a numerical variable ranging from 1-10, representing soil quality, where higher scores indicate better quality.
  • Crop Planted - a factor variable indicating the type of crop planted.
  • Region - a factor variable specifying the region (North or South).
  • Density of pests in the crop - a numerical variable indicating the density of pests in the crop.
  • Pest susceptibility - a factor variable with three levels (low, medium, high) representing how susceptible the given crop is to pests.
  • Fertiliser Type - a factor variable with two levels: Control and New.

The following visualisation shows the crop yield on the Y axis and the Soil Quality Index Score on the X axis. There are then dimensions built up from “aesthetics”.

Here, we have the colour as the crop type. We additionally have Pest Density as the size.

There are two panels: The left displays for the Control Fertiliser, and the right for the New Fertiliser.

We can compare the two fertilisers: In general, the points in the “New” panel tend to be higher than that of the “Control” panel. This suggests that the new fertiliser results in a higher yield than the control fertiliser, on average.

If we look at the pest density, in both panels there appears to be an increase in the crop yield when the pest density is smaller.

If we look at the Soil Quality Index Score, there is an increase in the crop yield as the index score increases. This seems to be at the same rate for both types of fertiliser so the fertiliser doesn’t appear to favour one soil quality over the other. Instead, the crop yield tends to increase as the index score increases.

There seems to be no difference in the performance between the three crop types. This is to say that while there is an increase in the yield in general in the “New” panel compared to the “Contol” panel, the three crops show no discernible difference between each other.

There seems overall to be a difference in the Fertiliser Type, Pest Density, and Soil Quality Index Score.

Download this data. This is not the same as the data used to make the graphic above. Using the downloaded data, create a similar visualisation.

In your graphic, which of the following variables would you say impacts the crop yield?
